Very thorough exploration of the trade system in D:\Claude Code+DeepSeekV4\city-life-story\src\js\phase1\trade.js. I need to understand:

1. How many goods/items are tradeable
2. What affects prices (price ranges, fluctuation rates, location effects)
3. How buyWholesale and sellGood work - the exact profit margins possible
4. How adjustPriceAfterTrade works
5. The price update mechanism (updateAllPrices)
6. What BASE_PRICES look like
7. Specifically: what is the maximum profit a player can make buying from one location and selling at another (especially wholesale→commercial district for electronics)

Also check D:\Claude Code+DeepSeekV4\city-life-story\src\js\data\goods.js for the goods definitions.

Read the complete files and report exact price formulas, profit calculations, and all tradeable items.
